name: John Hoppner

summary.text: John Hoppner was an English painter, very largely of portraits. He was much influenced by Joshua Reynolds, and was regarded as a fine colourist.
summary.title: John Hoppner

20180134: The Frankland Sisters is an oil painting on canvas by the British artist John Hoppner, from 1795. It is a double portrait of Amelia and Marianne, the two daughters of the Yorkshire landowner and politician Sir Thomas Frankland.
26693280: Portrait of Sir George Beaumont is an 1803 portrait painting by the British artist John Hoppner. It depicts the English landowner and art patron Sir George Beaumont, 7th Baronet.
28017645: Portrait of William Lamb is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the British artist John Hoppner, from 1796. It depicts the English aristocrat and future politician William Lamb as a seventeen-year old Etonian.
28048352: Dorothea Jordan as Hypolita is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the British artist John Hoppner, from 1791. It depicts the Irish actress Dorothea Jordan in one of her better known roles as Hypolita in the play She Would and She Would Not by Colley Cibber.
28048529: Portrait of Lord Grenville is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the English artist John Hoppner, from 1800. It depicts the British politician William Grenville, 1st Baron Grenville, later prime minister from 1806 to 1807.
107445325: Portrait of Lord Camden is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the British artist John Hoppner, from 1806. It depicts the politician John Pratt, Earl of Camden.
126083762: 'Portrait of Anne Isabella Milbanke is an 1800 portrait painting by the British artist John Hoppner. It depicts Anne Isabella Milbanke, the daughter of Ralph Noel a wealthy County Durham landowner at the age of seven.
136069007: Portrait of Arthur Wellesley is an oil on canvas portrait painting by the English artist John Hoppner depicting the Anglo-Irish soldier Arthur Wellesley. It was created in 1795.
